lines.text: You been down the south road? Then stay out of the bare glade, over the hollow bridge. There's two out there the size of calves. I've told everybody.
My granddad would've gone and had a word with them. He'd have been wrong to, mind. But he'd have gone.
It's a remark. I wouldn't ask it of a man with your knee. Only, if somebody shifted them, I'd want to hear about it.
Over the hollow bridge. You'll know them when you see them. They'll know you, too.
Hollow's gone quiet. That was you?
They've gone home. I only suggested it.
You'd better have this. Granddad's. He carried it on the walls for forty years and swore it was for the cold.
